pages.text: Full bags request cargo pickup; missing tools request one compatible spare with its item data intact. Farmers use hoes, lumberjacks axes, miners pickaxes/shovels, and fighters swords. Carriers do not supply seeds or saplings.

Miner fluid removal requests one empty bucket. Wall reinforcement requests up to 64 cobblestone. Healers request up to 64 slimeballs. Supply is limited by stock and usable space; full bags need unloading first. Fishers request rods; tunnel workers request up to 64 matching lining blocks.

Carriers recheck the request before delivery, so two carriers do not overfill it. Follow and Wait withdraw requests. $(l:companions/herald)Heralds$() report continuous blocked work; a retry alone does not erase that duration.
